The difference (in ₹ crore) between the total income of company B in 2015 and 2017 and the total expenditure of company A in 2016 and 2018 is x. The value of x lies between:

2f
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total income of company B in 2015 and 2017 = 160 + 225

⇒ 385

Total expenditure of company A in 2016 and 2018 = 125 + 175

⇒ 300

x =Total income of company B in 2015 and 2017 - Total expenditure of company A in 2016 and 2018

⇒ 385 - 300

⇒ 85

**∴ The value of x lies between 80 and 90.**
